tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per bid document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, the Consultant in its name should have in the last five years i.e., (2021-22 to 2025-26).Completed successfully at least ONE Consultancy Services in Construction Supervision/Project monitoring/Quality Control of Road Projects of Formation of roads, including asphalting, Construction of RCC side drains, RCC cross drainage & HDPE dual water supply pipe lines, etc., having value i.e., Rs.1183.00Lakhs during past five years.

Shall have minimum 5 years of experience in consultancy services (Credentials obtained from the client not below the rank of Executive Engineer shall be furnished indicating the work done and the consultancy fee obtained for such projects.)

The Consultant shall have a Full Fledged NABL Accredited Laboratory/MoRTH with all the relevant equipments with necessary qualified staff to conduct all the laboratory tests of the road project as per the MoRTH Specifications/IRC Guidelines/IS Codes/relevant codes.
